scripts.build: cd .. && npx electron-vite build && rm -rf relay/public/app && cp -R out/renderer relay/public/app && node -p "require('fs').readFileSync('src/shared/protocol.ts', 'utf8').match(/PROTOCOL = (\\d+)/)[1]" > relay/public/app/protocol.txt && cp relay/node_modules/jsqr/dist/jsQR.js relay/public/jsqr.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && sh -c '. ./.env 2>/dev/null; wrangler deploy ${RELAY_DOMAIN:+--domain "$RELAY_DOMAIN"}'
